[b]Wápìwan, the god of death, and the fall of Kon[/b]
[i]The humanity were thriving, the most successful of all gods creations, the third age creatures were created by clay, and the gods conceded them the gift of a soul, the creatures would be free to decide whatever they want, without gods intervention, unless demanded.
There was among the humans however, the false sensation of eternity, just like the gods, but we can not blame them, after all, not a single human died at  the time.
Where the Mayao encounters the inner sea, there was a city named Máchamò,  ruled by a elderly man, called Béchup Pañan, he was very ill and sick, on his death bed, no one could do anything, no human would be capable of helping the man, at least not without divine miracle, but what came was not divine, neither a miracle.
It emerged from the skies, it had a body of condor, but feathers dark as void, and it eyes carried something uncomfortable, making even the most sane person become insane by just looking at it, that was Wápìwan, the death, something the humans did not even know, those who tried to save the poor old man, were driven insane by the thing glancing their eyes into them, those who tried intervene, were driven insane, and the thing gone to the man, it talons pierced it flesh, taking a grey and translucid version of the man's body, and the death fly away Béchup never wake up again.
[b]Just like where is dark, there is light, Where is life, there must have death, i am not here to kill, but to bring stability[/b].
The creature proclaimed soon before fly away, but, Kon feel the darkness on his boneless body, it was the feeling of one of his creations dying, a feeling he did not had since he imprisioned his brother in the sea, could it be Samanteman again?, no...that should be impossible, as soon he moved with his agile and fast body to the creature, he shown disgust by it.
"You will not kill my creations "
He roared to the thing, his winds throwing trees at the thing, but it was...useless.
"You are not a god, you are not a creation of me or my brother, what are yo-"
"I am not a creation, neither a god, i am the what this world does not want, but needs, i am the [b]inevitable[/b]"
The divine winds did nothing to the creature, the trees were erased, soon the thing moved fast, in a single thrust with it claws, Kon had his body pierced,  his blood fallen making the last rivers of Erene, he was in pain, not for his wounds, but due his defeat, his fall from a supreme god, now being defeated, his last deed was look into Wápìwan eyes, he seen his fall , the death of every single human, every single creation killed by Samanteman, every single death in a second, that looked a eternity, he fallen from the skies, which darkened, Chilla and Chatay cried, making silver, gold and corn creation, now Kon no longer raisen to the Chomuñapû top, humilliated, he now wander around the mountains, while Chatay and Chilla emerged as new supreme gods.
[b]The fate of the dead.[/b]
Those who die, are accompanied by Wápìwan, who observes them on the corner of their vision, after their death, their spirit is taken away by it, it flies to Sùpâchó, with the souls imprisioned, where those who commited evil, are comndened to wander around the forest eternally seeking the Pâkatwan river, which they will never find, Sùpay, the "devil", usually diverts himself by torturing the impure souls, or making them one of his servents, those who did good, or at least remained as pure as possible and did not commit any bad deeds, are guided by Táncûy, the ferryman that guides the dead over the Pâkatwan in a wooden boat, each soul has a history to tell him, as a price to travel, a history of their lives, as much they want, after every soul finish their histories, Táncûy arrives the destination, the Wápítî, there is no torment, or any torture to those who arrive there, just peace, where at center, the Condor observes everything in his domains(Wápítî), and observe the living.

[/i]
[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP
